title: Halloumi Saganaki
description: A traditional Cyprus dish made with halloumi, all-purpose flour, lemon juice. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Pat dry, then coat evenly with the listed breading or flour components; press lightly to help it adhere.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 7 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
